## Verification (exact evidence)

- [ ] Ruff: command + result documented, or N/A
- [ ] Android unit tests and assembleDebug documented, or N/A

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, APKs, unapproved data, or unintended paths committed
- [ ] API/schema docs updated if any contract changed
- [ ] Latest CI result checked against this PR's HEAD SHA
- [ ] Conflicts/dependencies and combined regression risk reviewed

See `RULES.md` §1.3 and `docs/PR_WORKFLOW.md`. PRs remain open until reviewed, patched and expressly approved for merging.
